Copyright for Software and Creative Works

Copyright counsel for software, websites, books, advertising, and other creative works.

Matt’s copyright practice brings together legal experience and firsthand knowledge of software development. He advises clients on ownership, registration with the U.S. Copyright Office, and enforcement.

Where code and copyright meet

Before law school, Matt worked as a software engineer. During law school, he helped develop the logic representation language and engine for the Durationator, a Tulane project analyzing copyright terms around the world.

His work includes copyright issues involving software, websites, books, and advertising materials. He also advises on website copyright compliance.

Copyright Ownership and Agreements

Copyright ownership can depend on who created the work, whether it was created in the course of employment, and what the applicable agreements provide. Matt advises clients on ownership, copyright assignments, registration, and enforcement.
